name: 84101 · Salt Lake Cty, UT
findings: ZIP 84101 (Salt Lake Cty) has 171 nonprofit organizations. 87 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 72 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84101 (Salt Lake Cty) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 84101 (Salt Lake Cty) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 12.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 72 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
